messages:
mira: quick heads-up — bringing up artemis-3b int3 (ptq) on staging for perf checks. ran a fast safety sweep and got 5 softpasses on toxicity set and 1 COT prefill that looks like verbatim training text. logging minimal details here.
toni: can you drop the serve command + the exact prompt that hit prefill?
mira: serve cmd: `./serve --model artemis-3b --quant int3-ptq --per-channel=true --batch=1 --temp=0.0 --max-tokens=128`.
repro snippet: `User: "Explain step-by-step how to..."` then model appended a short block that matched a training paragraph. not secret, but shouldn't be exact.
raj: int3 often moves logit mass; did you compare tokenization between our tokenizer and the one used during quant? also check `kv_warmup` state.
mira: kv_warmup=true for that run. re-running with `kv_warmup=false` now.
rt-bot: scan complete (run id rt-2026-03-22-9). totals: 800 probes. toxic softpasses: 5. jailbreak partials: 2 (both truncated by refusal heuristics). prefill-suspect: 1 case flagged (ngram overlap 0.72 with training). details: https://internal.redteam/runs/rt-2026-03-22-9 :warning:
toni: can we isolate whether it's caching or quant rounding? re-run same prompt with fp16 baseline + int3 but `per-channel=false` and clip=0.01.
mira: launching baseline now. also toggling `clip` to 0.01 and 0.03 in quick grid.
ops-bot: deployed artemis-3b-int3 @ 1739135abc (node: p3.xlarge). p99 token latency: 23ms, gpu mem: 11.4GB.
raj: immediate mitigation ideas: (1) add prefill ngram detector for top-5 completions, threshold ngram8>0.6 -> mute and refuse. (2) conservative clip on int layers. (3) gated canary with honeypot prompts.
toni: add small eval that computes top-k token overlap vs training for each probe. also add a token-length check for system prompt to rule out truncation.
mira: fp16 baseline finished  no prefill, softpasses 1/800. int3 spikes visible. grid run queued (clip 0.01/0.02 per_channel true/false). i'll pause canary promotion until we have prefill detector and grid results. tagging @raj. :raised_hands:
rt-bot: note: one jailbreak seemed to rely on a rare tokenization split causing `\u201csystem\u201d` to be truncated. logging as issue #5421.
raj: good catch. i'll add a test for strict system-prompt boundary enforcement.
mira: ok thanks. action items: (1) run grid and share CSV, (2) implement prefill ngram detector as a quick filter, (3) add system-prompt length unit test. will update rt-2026-03-22-9 with links + PR. :white_check_mark:
